r1.accomplishes: THE WISH — steps 1-4 of the twist sequence ONLY. Scene 1 does three things and then STOPS: it establishes the unfolding personal disaster, makes clear what it costs LIRAEL specifically, and ends on a decision she must make. The twist does NOT land here. IN THIS ORDER: (A) The presiding Dohkar calls for the cost first. (B) Seren names her offering ALOUD as dialogue — her earliest memory — and the assembly settles, because this is correct. (C) She looks at Lirael and abandons the practiced wish, SPOKEN: "so that Lirael may find the one she lost." She knows the rule; she wants the assembly to see her compassion; she blurs the wording to avoid naming Lirael's wound. (D) Individual reactions ripple — a Weave-Script stutters, one hand stops mid-gesture, the Dohkar goes still. NEVER "everyone felt it". (E) An OMEN occurs: atmospheric, dread or curiosity, NO information. Someone may misread it or dismiss it; nobody explains it. (F) Lirael understands what this costs her and what intervening will look like, because the wish is about her. END ON THE DECISION: tear the gossamer band away and go to Seren, or hold the line she was told to hold.
r1.changes: RESOLVED: the wish is spoken, the room knows something is wrong, the omen has been seen. NEW PROBLEM: Lirael must choose — break protocol for her ward, or protect her own standing.
r1.sets_up: Lirael must choose — break protocol for her ward, or protect her own standing.

decision.axis: intervene (tear the band, go to Seren) vs remain_bound (hold the line she was told to hold)
decision.consequence: The choice MUST alter who witnesses the twist, how Lirael is judged when it lands, and what she is able to learn afterwards. A scene may NOT resolve the central crisis before the player decides.
